description: This Java class, JavaFieldsConsumer, implements ConfigurationConsumer and is responsible for collecting configuration field data and writing it into a Java source file named Fields.java. It manages the process of buffering variable definitions, writing them into a Java class, and handling configuration file processing events.

classes.name: JavaFieldsConsumer
classes.description: Implements ConfigurationConsumer to generate Java source file with configuration fields, manages writing and struct handling.

methods.name: writeFields
methods.description: Static method that writes accumulated variable data into a Java source file, constructing the class structure.

methods.name: JavaFieldsConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the consumer with output buffer, reader state, and console path.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: No-op method called at start of file processing.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Finalizes processing by writing out the Java fields source file.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles end of a configuration structure, writing its Java representation if the stack is empty.
